world: modern observed Hong Kong outer context; separate from fictional historical scene edits
sourceProduct: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public AWS 2021 release, matched to existing east tile
sourceType: Edited digital surface model (DSM), includes vegetation/buildings, not bare-earth DTM
coordinateRule: map X=E-834000; Z=827000-N; Y=H_EGM2008, metre units, no exaggeration
continuousFunction: H(E,N)=sum of shared tensor-product piecewise-linear hat basis fields at node steps 240,120,60,30m; each finer coefficient field is the residual needed against the previous reconstructed field. Query directly at arbitrary E,N, or regenerate sampled mesh on demand.
sharedKernel: height-spectrum.mjs; one evaluator for all chunks/cities using these coefficients
geometryNotTruth: Meshes are optional generated display caches; source observations and this versioned score remain separately addressable. Not geology, erosion simulation, historical reconstruction, or a guaranteed minimal code.
ownershipOrder: existing high-resolution local 2m/5m patches and frozen authored station terrain
existing frozen background/story edits inside original domain
this outer spectrum outside those owned domains
integrationModeDefault: exterior-only additive; do not change current loaded DEM or high-resolution patches
waterRule: official mask independent of height and independent of height LOD; retain 30m classification including single-node components; ocean display zero is not a tidal model; lake/river surface H remains source H
lodRule: Select height level using recorded local max error and camera budget. Coastal mask stays full resolution. Adjacent different height LODs require shared edge evaluation at the finer chosen level; do not fill gaps with arbitrary cliff skirts.
attribution: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved

qa.waterMaskIdentity: each output chunk roundtrips the exact projected official WBM bytes; no land threshold, smoothing, erosion, connected-component deletion or mask LOD
qa.coastlineAndIsletLimit: 1 arc-second source and nearest 30m reprojection cannot guarantee sub-cell rocks or shorelines. Retained tiny source components must not be discarded by renderer triangle masks.
qa.gzipTransportOnly: gzip wraps shared-basis coefficients and necessary residuals, not a claim of procedural terrain synthesis
